caption: A dolphin swimming fast bursts out of the sea, arcs through the air, and splashes back in.

sa.check: A dolphin swims fast near the surface.
It bursts out of the sea.
It is moving fast before the leap.
The burst comes first, then the arc, then the splash.

pc.expect: The dolphin follows one arc, its forward motion carrying through the leap.
pc.fail: The dolphin goes straight up and comes straight down; or it changes direction in mid-air; or it stops in the air.

pc.expect: It rises, slows at the top, and falls back to the water.
pc.fail: The dolphin hovers above the surface; or it rises again after starting to fall; or it lands and rests on top of the water.

pc.expect: The water breaks and sprays where the dolphin leaves, and there is a splash where it enters.
pc.fail: The dolphin exits leaving the surface flat; or it enters with no splash; or the splash appears where it did not enter.

pc.expect: Water streams off the body in the air and the splash falls back to the sea.
pc.fail: The splash hangs in the air; or the water stands rigid like glass; or the body squashes.

pc.expect: One dolphin keeps its fins and shape.
pc.fail: A fin detaches or vanishes; or a second dolphin appears from nowhere; or the dolphin turns into another creature.

pc.expect: The dolphin's colour, the sea and the horizon stay the same.
pc.fail: The dolphin changes colour; or the horizon shifts between frames; or the sea changes colour.
